narrative.intro: Sawtooth Construction JV Ii obligated $234M in FY2026 to date. Sawtooth Construction JV Ii received 9 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $26M and obligations up 868.7% year over year. Sawtooth Construction JV Ii had no recorded obligations in FY21, FY22, FY23, or FY24. Sawtooth Construction JV Ii obligated $24.2M in FY25 and then $234M in FY26, concentrating its FY2026 obligations in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $234M. Current-year totals are fiscal year to date and therefore partial. These figures are contract obligations except where tables note award values as total contract values.
